name: syntactic-metrics-desktop
description: Electron carrier shell for the syntactic complexity metrics toolkit
author: Syntactic Metrics Team

scripts.dev: npm run build && cross-env SYN_METRICS_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run prepack:assets && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run prepack:assets && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run prepack:assets && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run prepack:assets && electron-builder --linux
